b2-15-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Nobody Says Who
b2-15-01.scenario: A neighbour asks you why nobody knows where Ancsa Jánosné's husband, the engineer, is.
b2-15-01.prompt: Tell your neighbour what was done to the engineer and what was done with the facts, without saying who did it.
cues: Say that the engineer was arrested
Say that the whole matter was kept silent
b2-15-01.target: Letartóztatták a mérnököt, és az egész ügyet elhallgatták.
b2-15-01.english: The engineer was arrested, and the whole matter was kept silent.
b2-15-01.canDo: I can use agentless 3rd-person plural verbs to state that an action occurred without naming who did it.

b2-15-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Notice from the Ministry
b2-15-02.scenario: Ancsa Jánosné asks a clerk at the ministry when the new rule will start. The clerk answers in the formal style.
b2-15-02.prompt: As the clerk, tell her formally what will happen to the new rule next month.
cues: Say when it starts, in the formal style
b2-15-02.target: Az új szabály a jövő hónapban bevezetésre kerül.
b2-15-02.english: The new rule will be introduced next month.
b2-15-02.canDo: I can recognize and formulate formal administrative statements using -ásra/-ésre kerül.

b2-15-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Careful Words
b2-15-03.scenario: A neighbour asks Ancsa Jánosné what the officials said about her husband. She answers carefully, without a harsh word.
b2-15-03.prompt: Tell the neighbour, in a careful way, what the officials told you.
cues: Use a softening word about how they spoke
b2-15-03.target: Úgy tűnik, a hatóságok némiképp óvatosan beszéltek.
b2-15-03.english: It seems that the authorities spoke somewhat cautiously.
b2-15-03.canDo: I can soften harsh criticisms and delicate assessments using némiképp and bizonyos értelemben.

b2-15-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Between the Lines
b2-15-04.scenario: A friend has just read the story of Niki and asks you why the writer does not say outright what happened to the engineer.
b2-15-04.prompt: Tell your friend how the writer speaks about the hard years.
cues: Say how the writer criticises the system
Say what the reader has to do
b2-15-04.target: A szerző rejtetten bírálta a rendszert, ezért a sorok között kell olvasni.
b2-15-04.english: The author criticised the system covertly, so one has to read between the lines.
b2-15-04.canDo: I can recognize Aesopian language and indirect political subtext in historical texts.

b2-15-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Calm Letter
b2-15-05.scenario: Ancsa Jánosné writes another letter to the ministry about her husband. Her friend helps her to write one calm sentence without blaming anyone.
b2-15-05.prompt: Help her write one calm, impersonal sentence for the letter.
cues: Say that the matter needs more clarification
b2-15-05.target: Úgy tűnik, az ügy további tisztázásra szorul.
b2-15-05.english: It seems that the matter needs further clarification.
b2-15-05.canDo: I can rewrite aggressive, accusatory sentences into polished, impersonal administrative Hungarian.

b2-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Story of Niki
b2-15-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks you what happened to the engineer in the story of Niki and how it all ended.
b2-15-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend what was done and what was kept silent, and how it ended.
cues: Say what happened to the engineer
Say that the truth came out in the end
b2-15-consolidation.target: A mérnököt letartóztatták, de az ügyet elhallgatták, és sok év után kiderült az igazság.
b2-15-consolidation.english: The engineer was arrested, but the matter was kept silent, and after many years the truth came out.
b2-15-consolidation.canDo: I can background the agent naturally using 3rd-person plural verbs and middle verbs in -ódik/-ődik.
